newsitem.title: CANADA: CBRS reassigns new rating to Scott's debt.
newsitem.headline: CBRS reassigns new rating to Scott's debt.

text.p: Canadian Bond Rating Service said on Friday it reassigned a new rating of B++ to the former Scott's Hospitality Inc's unsecured debentures, series A and B, following Laidlaw Inc's purchase of Scott's school bus business.

In assuming Scott's outstanding debt, previously rated A(Low) by CBRS, such debentures are now the obligation of Laidlaw, CBRS said. Laidlaw's senior unsecured debt is rated at the medium quality level of B++, hence Scott's outstanding debentures are technically downgraded to that level since they rank pari passu with Laidlaw's senior unsecured debentures.
